flows.headline: Finally solved. No more tutorials.

flows.headline: Solve it the right way, move by move.
flows.paywall_opens_on: Weekly, with Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced and “You start here” on their answer

flows.headline: Every solve timed. Beat your best.

flows.note: asks “What’s your best time on a 3x3?”; the paywall reads “Beat 1:42.36” (an example time)
